news.title: Butler Welcomes More Than 1,200 New Undergraduate Students for 2026–2027
news.summary_en: As a new academic year begins at Butler University, more than 1,200 new undergraduate students are joining the Butler community, bringing strong academic credentials, a wide range of interests, and experiences from across Indiana, the country, and the world. This fall, Butler welcomes 1,053 first-year students, 102 transfer students, and 53 new students in Founder’s…
news.author: Mark Apple
